hook.line: Your first paper in Spanish needs an opening paragraph, and readers decide there whether to keep going. Papers announce their own plan in a few fixed phrases, so you can borrow them whole.
hook.es: El presente trabajo se centra en la vivienda informal en Bogotá.
hook.en: This paper focuses on informal housing in Bogotá.

examples.es: El presente trabajo se centra en la vivienda informal en Bogotá.
examples.en: This paper focuses on informal housing in Bogotá.

examples.es: Este escrito se propone analizar el impacto del transporte público.
examples.en: This paper aims to analyse the impact of public transport.

examples.es: En primer lugar se expondrá el marco teórico.
examples.en: First, the theoretical framework will be set out.

examples.es: A continuación se presentarán los resultados.
examples.en: Next, the results will be presented.

examples.es: Por último, se discutirán las conclusiones.
examples.en: Finally, the conclusions will be discussed.

examples.es: El presente artículo se ocupa de la memoria de la ciudad.
examples.en: This article deals with the memory of the city.

rule:
A paper talks about itself in the third person: *el presente trabajo*, *este escrito*, *el presente artículo*. Then it names its aim with *se propone* + infinitive, or its topic with *se centra en* or *se ocupa de*.

The plan uses *se* + the future, with the order marked by *en primer lugar*, *a continuación*, *por último*. English says "will be presented"; Spanish says *se presentarán*. The verb agrees with what is presented: *se expondrá el marco*, *se presentarán los resultados*.
smallPrint: Teachers call this the *se* passive in the future, used for the roadmap of an academic text.

readAndPick.es: En primer lugar se expondrá el marco teórico.
options: First, the theoretical framework will be set out.
First, the theoretical framework was set out.
First, I set out the theoretical framework.

readAndPick.es: A continuación se presentarán los resultados.
options: Next, the result will be presented.
Next, the results will be presented.
Next, the results were presented.

readAndPick.es: Este escrito se propone analizar el transporte público.
options: This paper was analysed by public transport.
This paper aims to analyse public transport.
This paper proposes public transport to me.

readAndPick.es: Por último, se discutirán las conclusiones.
options: Finally, the conclusions will be discussed.
Finally, the conclusion will be discussed.
Finally, the conclusions were discussed.

readAndPick.es: A continuación se describirá el método.
options: Next, the method was described.
Next, the methods will be described.
Next, the method will be described.

readAndPick.es: El presente trabajo se centra en la vivienda informal.
options: This paper focuses on informal housing.
This paper was centred on informal housing.
I focus this paper on informal housing.

readAndPick.es: En segundo lugar se analizarán tres casos.
options: Second, three cases were analysed.
Second, one case will be analysed.
Second, three cases will be analysed.

readAndPick.es: El presente artículo se ocupa de la memoria de la ciudad.
options: This article is occupied by the city.
This article deals with the memory of the city.
This article remembers the city.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick *se centra* or *se centran* and type the whole sentence: *El presente trabajo ___ en la vivienda informal.*
yourTurn.answer: El presente trabajo se centra en la vivienda informal.
yourTurn.why: One paper, so the verb is singular: *se centra*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: First, the theoretical framework will be set out.
yourTurn.answer: En primer lugar se expondrá el marco teórico.
accept: En primer lugar, se expondrá el marco teórico.
yourTurn.why: *Se* + future, and the verb agrees with the one framework: *se expondrá*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: Next, the results will be presented.
yourTurn.answer: A continuación se presentarán los resultados.
accept: A continuación, se presentarán los resultados.
yourTurn.why: The results are plural, so the verb is plural: *se presentarán*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: This paper aims to analyse public transport.
yourTurn.answer: Este escrito se propone analizar el transporte público.
accept: El presente trabajo se propone analizar el transporte público.
Este trabajo se propone analizar el transporte público.
yourTurn.why: *Se propone* + infinitive names the aim of the paper.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: Finally, the conclusions will be discussed.
yourTurn.answer: Por último, se discutirán las conclusiones.
accept: Por último se discutirán las conclusiones.
yourTurn.why: *Por último* closes the list, and the plural *conclusiones* takes *se discutirán*.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it plural: *Se analizará el caso.* Say: The cases will be analysed.
yourTurn.why: More than one case means the verb ending changes too: *se analizarán*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: Next, the method will be explained.
yourTurn.answer: A continuación se explicará el método.
accept: A continuación, se explicará el método.
yourTurn.why: One method, so the verb stays singular: *se explicará*.

pitfalls.wrong: Este papel se propone analizar el transporte público.
pitfalls.right: Este escrito se propone analizar el transporte público.
pitfalls.why: Almost. *Papel* is a sheet of paper; a written piece is *un escrito* or *un trabajo*.

pitfalls.wrong: En primer lugar se expondrán el marco teórico.
pitfalls.right: En primer lugar se expondrá el marco teórico.
pitfalls.why: Almost. The verb agrees with what is set out, and there is only one framework.

pitfalls.wrong: El presente trabajo se centra la vivienda informal.
pitfalls.right: El presente trabajo se centra en la vivienda informal.
pitfalls.why: Almost. *Centrarse* always takes *en* before the topic.

personal: Write the opening line of a paper about something you care about, starting with *El presente trabajo se centra en*.
